symmetry_justification: a counterexample has at least seven silent directions; PGL(2,31) is triply transitive on projective functional directions, and its contragredient action preserves antipodal point weight and permutes the fifteen nonzero-square affine blocks within each direction
coverage_argument: Every six-set silent in directions 0,1,31 has zero total 45-bit parity signature. Each of its ten unordered 3+3 partitions is therefore a disjoint pair of enumerated triples with equal signatures. Every such collision pair was checked by recomputing all 32 direction parities from the six point indices.
independent_replay: scripts.p31_group_branch_cms.verify reconstructed the displayed support with support_weight=6, silent_direction_indices=[0,1,10,21,30,31], active_direction_count=26, group_branch_weight=32, counterexample=false
scope: Exact closure only of the p=31 grouped-uncertainty decision problem at point weight six; not the full grouped inequality, row-code distance, residual (ii), E1, or the original MO limit.
